visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit modern living room with beige curtains and a white sofa, a man wearing a blue baseball cap backwards and a black 'ALL-STAR' sweatshirt stands next to a woman in a black tank top. They are positioned behind a white table covered with various chocolate boxes, including Hershey's and Meiji. The man uses his right hand to gesture toward the camera while the woman smiles warmly. (2) The man holds up three packs of gold-wrapped Ferrero Rocher chocolates to the camera lens. He then presents a yellow cardboard box with a transparent window showing a Ferrero Rocher Christmas snow globe. He removes the globe from its plastic housing and shakes it vigorously, showing gold glitter swirling around a miniature golden tree and building inside the glass dome. (3) The man displays two different flavors of Hershey's chocolate bars in blue and brown packaging. He then introduces a small, transparent zip pouch branded with the Hershey's logo, which contains a miniature chocolate bar and several green and red decorative pompoms. He handles the pouch to show the keychain attachment while the woman looks on and gestures with a peace sign. (4) The woman holds up several dark brown bags of Hershey's Kisses. She then holds a pink square box that contains a specialized Hershey's Kisses snow globe. As she shakes the globe, white artificial snow falls over a miniature scene of a colorful house and a golden kiss-shaped object. The background remains the same warm-toned indoor room with an air conditioner visible. (5) The woman presents a stack of Meiji milk chocolate bars in green and black packaging. She then picks up a red patterned box and reveals a Meiji-branded snow globe. This globe features a small snowman wearing a red hat and a decorated Christmas tree. She shakes the globe close to the camera, allowing the white snow inside to swirl around the festive figures. (6) The man and woman stand together, each holding two of the promotional gift items they just unboxed. The man holds the Hershey's pouch and the Ferrero globe, while the woman holds the Hershey's Kisses globe and the Meiji globe. They address the camera directly with energetic facial expressions, inviting viewers to leave comments on their favorite item.

It aims to inform viewers about the specific items—snow globes and pouches—that can be obtained by purchasing certain quantities of branded chocolates like Ferrero Rocher, Hershey's, and Meiji.
